comparison.objective: Seat and hold a push-type grease coupler on a nipple while pumping multiple strokes without leakage, then return the coupler.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sealed axial seating under push-off force, sustained holding, hose management and repeated lever strokes; no moving block crosses a support junction.
comparison.success_condition: Requires four valid pump shots while the coupler remains sealed, no leak, and tool return; candidate requires full bearing-block transfer with all balls retained and no interface gap, contamination or damage.
comparison.reason: Although both demand aligned contact and continuous bimanual control, the record tests maintaining a pressure seal while remotely pumping. The candidate uniquely tests a translating uncaged bearing whose free elements can escape during support handoff. Candidate numeric seal-equivalent tolerances are absent, but the mechanisms remain distinct.
